# AISLO

> AISLO is AI visibility software for ecommerce brands. It manages product feeds in one place (Google Merchant Center, ChatGPT, Shopify Catalog, Microsoft Merchant Center, Meta catalog), checks the files AI crawlers read (product metadata, structured data, robots.txt, agents.md), tracks how ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Shopify Catalog recommend products, writes fixes for approval, and ties AI referrals to revenue.

Key facts:
- Company: AISLO Technologies Ltd, registered in the United Kingdom. Contact: hello@useaislo.com
- Built for: ecommerce brands and retailers on Shopify and other platforms (WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, custom).
- Pricing: quoted on SKU count, integrations and support level. Every engagement starts with a free AI visibility audit. Unlimited team seats.
- Platform watch: tracks news and specification changes across 14 AI shopping platforms daily and updates checks automatically.
- Changes to feeds, listings or site files are only made after the customer approves them. Analytics and Search Console access is read only.

## Product
- [Platform](https://useaislo.com/product): Measure, fix, prove, connect and watch.
